name: Certified Ethical Hacker

fee.note: US$1,199 at a Pearson VUE test centre. Without official training, a non-refundable US$100 eligibility application fee comes first. Training partners bundle the voucher with courses at prices that vary by region and partner; EC-Council does not set them.

exam.format: 125 multiple-choice questions in 4 hours, remotely proctored through EC-Council's exam portal or at a Pearson VUE test centre; not open book. The optional CEH (Practical) is a separate 6-hour exam with 20 hands-on challenges; holding both earns the CEH Master designation.

scope: Ethical hacking methods and tools: reconnaissance, scanning and enumeration, system hacking and malware, network and perimeter attacks, web application, wireless, mobile, IoT/OT and cloud hacking, and cryptography.
requirements: Eligibility comes from official EC-Council training (an Accredited Training Center, EC-Council's online learning or an academic partner) or, without training, an approved eligibility application: verifiable proof of at least two years of information security work in the exam domains and a non-refundable US$100 fee. Approval usually takes 5–10 working days and lasts 90 days; a voucher is valid for one year.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. EC-Council markets CEH v13 as AI-powered (AI tools in the course and labs); that is course content, not permission to use AI during the exam.
caveats: Version 13 is current. EC-Council says new versions come every 12–18 months; none was announced on its pages read 2026-11-17.
Renewal: 120 EC-Council continuing education credits in each three-year window plus an annual US$80 continuing education fee.
Retakes are bought separately unless a training package includes them; at most five attempts in 12 months, with 14-day waits from the third attempt.

EC-Council's pages disagree on delivery: the certification page lists the ECC Exam Centre and Pearson VUE, while a FAQ on the same page says the exam is only available at the ECC Exam Centre. The store sells both vouchers.
